subject: Upcoming company event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day!
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming Annual Employee Appreciation Day on Friday, April 23rd. This year, we have planned a fun-filled day with team-building activities, games, and a delicious catered lunch. We want to take this opportunity to thank each of you for your hard work and dedication. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details about the event schedule. We look forward to celebrating with all of you! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
